Quick start: wire into your MCP host

Open Program tab → Install → Edit mcp.json in LM Studio, or edit the file directly:

~/.lmstudio/mcp.json 


            

              
              Copied
            

            

              Gotcha: when pasting manually, copy only the
              content between "mcpServers": { and the matching
              closing brace. LM Studio merges into the existing top-level key.

              Then open AnythingLLM → Settings → MCP Servers. The server
              appears with status, error logs, and reload/restart controls.
            

            

              Disable auto-start (optional)
              

                Add "anythingllm": { "autoStart": false } under
                the server entry to prevent AnythingLLM from starting it on
                app launch (useful on resource-constrained machines).
